question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence to fill in the blank.**

We usually had ______ visitors dropping by, but now we have **__very l**__ess visitors.
solution:
The correct answer is **"umpteen."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word is **"very less,"** which indicates a decrease in the number of visitors. (बहुत कम)

 
 
• **Example: ***The hardware complexity of the involution block is **very less**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Umpteen" **means a large, unspecified number. (बहुत बार; बहुत सारे, बहुतेरे, बहुत-से)
 __
 
• **Example:** *We've been there **umpteen**__ times and she still can't remember the way.*
 
 
 
• **"Umpteen"** is an antonym for **"very less."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence:** *We usually had __**umpteen**__ visitors dropping by, but now we have very less visitors.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Insufficient"** means not enough. (अपर्याप्त, नाकाफ़ी)
 
• **"A handful of"** means a small number. (कम संख्या)
 
• **"Slighter" **means smaller in amount or degree. (बहुत छोटा; बड़ा या गंभीर नहीं, मामूली)
